---
name: statement-check
description: Reconciles a bank statement against the ledger and lists what does not match. Use when the user says "reconcile my statement", "check the bank export", or asks why the balance is off.
---

# Statement check

1. Read the statement export and the ledger the user named.
2. Match rows by date and amount; list the unmatched rows from each side.
3. Print the difference between the two balances.
